newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps- Jet fuel firm on healthy bids.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps- Jet fuel firm on healthy bids.

text.p: Strong bids for physical jet fuel cargoes pushed March jet/gas oil regrade firmer, traders said on Monday.
Gas oil swaps also tipped higher on healthy bids, traders said on Monday.
"Aggressive bids from a local buyer for physical jet cargoes have been pushing the regrades firmer," said a broker.
March jet/gas oil spread firmed to $1.60/$1.95 a barrel, up from last Friday's quotes at $1.40/$1.80.
Traders said a local trader might be covering their sales into Indonesia.

March gas oil swaps were up slightly to be quoted at $25.10/$25.30, from Friday's $25.05/$25.15 and traded earlier at $25.10 and $25.20 per barrel. April gas oil traded at $24.17 and $24.20 and was last quoted at $24.15/$24.25, slightly under Friday's $24.25/$24.35.
Traders said gas oil prices were expected to remain supported by some players who are pricing out to Indonesia.
India's award of three gas oil cargoes of 40,000 to 45,000 tonnes in its second tender for April were within market expectations. "Prices were not affected at all", said one trader.
Fuel oil was under pressure on thin cash demand and weaker crude prices. Levels dipped slightly by 50 cents per tonne with March last quoted at $96.00/$98.00.
